sloka: विद्धमन्योन्यगात्रेषु द्विगुणं वर्धते परम्।कृतप्रतिकृतान्योन्यं कुरुतां तौ रणाजिरे ।। ६.७९.२६ ।।
transliteration: viddhamanyonyagātreṣu dviguṇaṁ vardhate param।kṛtapratikṛtānyonyaṁ kurutāṁ tau raṇājire ।। 6.79.26 ।।

translations.english: Even though they were piercing one another with limbs, their strength remained doubled in the battlefield. Each of them was countering the other and inflicting and hitting each other.
translations.hindi: उक ८०४ युद्धकाण्डे तदनन्तर परम तेजस्वी जाम्चवान्‌ ने हनुमान्‌ जी से कहा - | हे बानरशदूल ! आओ ओर वानरो के प्राण बचाओ
